{'translation': "In addition to the ongoing $50 discount on AirPods Pro 3, today's 9to5Toys 'Afternoon Picks' headlines also bring the titanium 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 down by $184, aluminum Cellular models down by $130, and other models starting from $299. Rare deals on the Apple Keyboard and black Magic Mouse are still going strong (for whatever reason), and my personal favorite — the Anker Prime power bank that doubles as a wall charger — also has a solid discount. However, the real star of today's accessory deals is Nomad's anniversary sitewide sale, featuring rare discounts on MagSafe chargers, phone cases, and the F Series.", 'original': '除了 AirPods Pro 3 持續享有 50 美元折扣外，今天 9to5Toys「下午精選」的頭條更帶來鈦金屬 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 減價 184 美元、鋁金屬 Cellular 型號減 130 美元，以及其他由 299 美元起嘅型號。Apple 鍵盤同黑色 Magic Mouse 嘅罕見優惠仍然強勢進行中（無論點解），而我個人最鍾意嘅 Anker Prime 充電寶兼具牆插充電器功能，亦都有唔錯嘅折扣。不過今日配件優惠嘅真正主角係 Nomad 週年慶全站大減價，包括 MagSafe 充電器、手機殼同 F 系列嘅罕見折扣'}

{'translation': 'Grab the all-new AirPods Pro 3 for nearly $50 off this summer, with other models starting from $99', 'original': '趁今個夏天以接近 50 美元折扣入手全新 AirPods Pro 3，其他型號由 99 美元起'}

  • {'translation': 'AirPods Pro 3\u3000$200 (originally $249)', 'original': 'AirPods Pro 3\u3000200 美元（原價 249 美元）'}
  • {'translation': 'AirPods 4\u3000$99 (originally $129)', 'original': 'AirPods 4\u300099 美元（原價 129 美元）'}
  • {'translation': 'AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation)\u3000$149 (originally $179)', 'original': 'AirPods 4（主動降噪版）\u3000149 美元（原價 179 美元）'}

{'translation': 'Back in stock: Amazon has the 46mm titanium Apple Watch Series 11 down $184', 'original': '再度返貨：亞馬遜 46mm 鈦金屬 Apple Watch Series 11 減價 184 美元'}

{'translation': "This deal sold out in a flash yesterday — if you're interested, don't hesitate today. The 46mm GPS + Cellular Apple Watch Series 11 with Slate titanium case is once again discounted by $184 on Amazon.", 'original': '呢個優惠昨日瞬間售罄——如果有興趣，今日就唔好再猶豫。配備 Slate 鈦金屬錶殼嘅 46mm GPS + Cellular 版 Apple Watch Series 11 再度於亞馬遜減價 184 美元。'}

{'translation': 'Amazon is currently selling the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular with Slate titanium case and black sport band for $564.97, with free shipping.', 'original': '亞馬遜目前以 564.97 美元發售配備 Slate 鈦金屬錶殼同黑色運動錶帶嘅 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular 版，包郵。'}

{'translation': "This is the premium titanium case model, originally priced at $749. Take advantage of this potentially fleeting deal today to save $184 — it's one of the best prices we've recorded for this configuration. It briefly dropped to $550 before Prime Day last month, but aside from that, this combo's lowest price is this one.", 'original': '呢款屬於高階鈦金屬錶殼型號，原價 749 美元。趁今日呢個可能稍縱即逝嘅優惠慳返 184 美元——係我哋記錄到嘅呢個配置最佳價格之一。上個月 Prime Day 之前曾短暫跌至 550 美元，但除此之外，呢個組合嘅最低價就係今次。'}

{'translation': "Again, this deal is really only for those who insist on the Slate titanium case — because even with the discount, it's not exactly cheap. However, the more popular aluminum models in the Series 11 lineup also have $100 and $130 discounts this week:", 'original': '再強調一次，呢個優惠只適合堅持要 Slate 鈦金屬錶殼嘅人——因為即使有折扣，價錢都唔算平。不過，Series 11 系列中較受歡迎嘅鋁金屬型號今個禮拜亦有 100 美元同 130 美元嘅折扣：'}

  • {'translation': '42mm Apple Watch Series 11\u3000$299 (originally $399)', 'original': '42mm Apple Watch Series 11\u3000299 美元（原價 399 美元）'}
  • {'translation': '46mm Apple Watch Series 11\u3000$329 (originally $429)', 'original': '46mm Apple Watch Series 11\u3000329 美元（原價 429 美元）'}
  • {'translation': '42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular\u3000from $399 (originally $499)', 'original': '42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular\u3000399 美元起（原價 499 美元）'}
  • {'translation': '46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular\u3000from $399 (originally $529)', 'original': '46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular\u3000399 美元起（原價 529 美元）'}

{'translation': 'Rare Apple Keyboard and black Magic Mouse deals (for whatever reason) are still ongoing, with historic lows starting from $80', 'original': '罕見嘅 Apple 鍵盤同黑色 Magic Mouse 優惠（無論點解）仍然持續，歷史低價由 80 美元起'}

{'translation': 'Apple product deals are abundant — $50 off AirPods Pro 3, up to $130 off the most popular Apple Watch Series 11 models — but Magic accessory deals are rather rare. However, the basic Magic Keyboard, the full-size model with Touch ID, and the black Apple Magic Mouse are still enjoying extended Prime Day discounts.', 'original': 'Apple 產品優惠多多——AirPods Pro 3 減 50 美元、最受歡迎嘅 Apple Watch Series 11 型號減最多 130 美元——但 Magic 配件嘅優惠就比較罕見。不過，基本版 Magic Keyboard、配備 Touch ID 嘅全尺寸型號，以及黑色 Apple Magic Mouse 仍然享有延長 Prime Day 折扣。'}

{'translation': 'Before these extended Prime Day discounts, deals on Apple accessories like these were extremely rare, and how long these deals will last is hard to predict.', 'original': '喺呢啲延長 Prime Day 折扣之前，類似嘅 Apple 配件優惠極為罕見，呢啲優惠能夠維持幾耐都好難預測。'}

  • {'translation': 'Black Apple Magic Mouse\u3000$80 (originally $99)', 'original': '黑色 Apple Magic Mouse\u300080 美元（原價 99 美元）'}
  • {'translation': 'Apple Magic Keyboard\u3000$80 (originally $99)', 'original': 'Apple Magic Keyboard\u300080 美元（原價 99 美元）'}
  • {'translation': 'Full-size Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID\u3000$145 (originally $179)', 'original': '配備 Touch ID 嘅全尺寸 Apple Magic Keyboard\u3000145 美元（原價 179 美元）'}

{'translation': "All three products are at the lowest prices we've recorded on Amazon. The black Apple Magic Mouse hasn't dropped this low in ages (I'm planning to grab a backup myself), while both Magic Keyboards are at historic lows — the basic version has only dropped to this price once before, and the Touch ID version has never been below $158.", 'original': '呢三款產品都係我哋喺亞馬遜記錄到嘅最低價。黑色 Apple Magic Mouse 好耐無跌到咁低（我自己都打算買多個後備），而兩款 Magic Keyboard 都處於歷史低價——基本版之前只試過一次跌到呢個價位，而 Touch ID 版就從未低過 158 美元。'}

{'translation': "If you've been looking to replace your Apple Magic input gear, now that Prime Day prices are still going might be the best time.", 'original': '如果你一直想換掉手上嘅 Apple Magic 輸入裝備，趁而家 Prime Day 價仲持續，可能就係最佳時機。'}

{'translation': 'Nomad anniversary sitewide sale officially kicks off: rare deals on MagSafe chargers, phone cases, watch bands, and more', 'original': 'Nomad 週年慶全站大減價正式開鑼：MagSafe 充電器、手機殼、手錶帶等罕見優惠'}

{'translation': 'Rare 20% off: Nomad Metal and Glass 25W Qi2 MagSafe Stand', 'original': '罕見 8 折優惠：Nomad Metal and Glass 25W Qi2 MagSafe 座檯充電器'}

{'translation': "There are indeed plenty of cheaper 25W Qi2 MagSafe stands on the market, but almost none can match the texture and looks of Nomad's latest model. The price isn't exactly cheap, but as the brand's 2026 anniversary sale kicks off, we've spotted rare discounts on 2-in-1 and 3-in-1 models that can handle charging for your entire Apple peripheral setup.", 'original': '市面上確實有唔少更便宜嘅 25W Qi2 MagSafe 座檯充電器，但幾乎無一款可以好似 Nomad 最新型號咁咁有質感同咁靚。價錢唔算平，但隨住品牌嘅 2026 週年慶開展，我哋搵到 2 合 1 同 3 合 1 型號嘅罕見折扣，可以應付你整套 Apple 外置裝置嘅充電需求。'}

{'translation': "Nomad's 2026 anniversary sale is officially underway, with massive discounts on iPhone 17 cases, wallets, Apple Watch bands, and other charging accessories — but the discounts on models like the Stand One and Stand One Max are the rarest of all:", 'original': 'Nomad 2026 週年慶正式開跑，iPhone 17 保護殼、銀包、Apple Watch 錶帶同其他充電配件都有巨額折扣——但 Stand One 同 Stand One Max 等型號嘅折扣就最為罕見：'}

  • {'translation': 'Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One\u3000$103 (originally $129)', 'original': 'Nomad 2 合 1 25W Qi2 Stand One\u3000103 美元（原價 129 美元）'}
  • {'translation': 'Nomad 3-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One Max\u3000$135 (originally $169)', 'original': 'Nomad 3 合 1 25W Qi2 Stand One Max\u3000135 美元（原價 169 美元）'}

{'translation': "What you're seeing is Nomad's latest generation 25W Qi2 MagSafe stand. It's currently being sold at 20% off, which doesn't sound like much, but these products almost never go on sale.", 'original': '你而家見到嘅係 Nomad 最新一代 25W Qi2 MagSafe 座檯充電器。現正以 8 折發售，聽落唔算多，但呢啲產品幾乎從來唔會減價。'}

{'translation': 'All-metal body with hefty, premium build quality, accented with glass, providing an elegant and luxurious home for your Apple devices.', 'original': '全金屬機身，份量十足嘅高階造工，配以玻璃點綴，為你嘅 Apple 裝置提供優雅奢華嘅安身之所。'}

{'translation': "The only downside to this discount is that the new Cosmic Orange colorway isn't included:", 'original': '今次減價唯一美中不足嘅係全新 Cosmic Orange 配色並未包含在內：'}

{'translation': 'Rare discount: Nomad Tracking Card — Apple Find My Pro model, Cosmic Orange, Google Find Hub, and more', 'original': '罕見折扣：Nomad Tracking Card——Apple Find My Pro 型號、Cosmic Orange、Google Find Hub 等'}

{'translation': "Nomad's anniversary sale is officially underway. Although there was some confusion regarding previous discounts on the Tracking Card Pro and Air, they're now officially in effect. The discount amounts aren't large, but they are rare price drops — Apple Find My and Google Find Hub versions start from $32.", 'original': 'Nomad 週年慶正式開跑。雖然之前對 Tracking Card Pro 同 Air 嘅折扣有啲混亂，但而家已經正式生效。折扣金額唔算大，但係罕見嘅減價——Apple Find My 同 Google Find Hub 版本由 32 美元起。'}

{'translation': "Nomad's tracking cards are arguably the gold standard in their category, supporting MagSafe wireless charging — a must-have whenever I head out:", 'original': 'Nomad 嘅追蹤卡可謂同類產品嘅黃金標準，支援 MagSafe 無線充電——我出門必備：'}

  • {'translation': 'Tracking Card Air\u3000$32 (originally $35) Apple Find My or Google Find Hub version', 'original': 'Tracking Card Air\u300032 美元（原價 35 美元）Apple Find My 或 Google Find Hub 版本'}
  • {'translation': 'Tracking Card Pro\u3000$41 (originally $45) Three colors', 'original': 'Tracking Card Pro\u300041 美元（原價 45 美元）三種顏色'}

{'translation': 'Nomad Titanium Stratos Apple Watch Band anniversary 20% off (rare discount)', 'original': 'Nomad Titanium Stratos Apple Watch 錶帶週年慶 8 折優惠（罕見折扣）'}

{'translation': 'The Anker Prime power bank with display that doubles as a wall charger drops to $70 this summer — my personal favorite', 'original': '配備顯示屏兼可當牆插充電器嘅 Anker Prime 充電寶今個夏天跌至 70 美元——我個人最愛'}

{'translation': "Anker's 2026 summer sale is still ongoing, with hefty discounts on the latest Prime charging devices, chargers, desktop chargers, 25W MagSafe stands, and more. One of my personal favorite portable charging products from the brand has also dropped back to its 2026 low of $69.99 — this 9,600mAh Anker Prime power bank that doubles as a wall charger.", 'original': 'Anker 2026 夏季優惠持續進行中，最新 Prime 充電裝置、充電器、桌面充電器、25W MagSafe 座檯充電器等都有豐厚折扣。品牌中我個人最愛嘅便攜充電產品之一亦都回落至 2026 年低價 69.99 美元——呢款 9,600mAh Anker Prime 充電寶同時兼具牆插充電器功能。'}

{'translation': "This 9,600mAh Anker Prime power bank is currently selling on Amazon for $69.99, with free shipping. Originally priced as high as $90, we've recorded this deal multiple times this year, but I want to make sure we don't miss it this week, because it's been the most practical everyday portable charging device for me over the past year.", 'original': '呢款 9,600mAh Anker Prime 充電寶現正於亞馬遜以 69.99 美元發售，包郵。原價高達 90 美元，我哋今年多次記錄到呢個優惠，但我希望確保今個禮拜唔會錯過，因為佢已經係我近一年來最實用嘅日常便攜充電裝置。'}

{'translation': "Of course, there are higher-powered chargers in the brand's new product line that offer larger capacity and faster charging output, but this one is already more than enough for my needs. It's one of the lighter models, easily fitting into my carry-on, while featuring a smart display, USB-C connectivity, and enough battery to last through a full day out — or even longer.", 'original': '當然，品牌新產品線中有更高功率嘅充電器，提供更大容量同更快充電輸出，但呢款已經足以滿足我嘅需要。佢係較為輕巧嘅型號之一，輕鬆放入我嘅隨身行李，同時配備智能顯示屏、USB-C 連接，以及足夠撐過一整天外出使用——甚至更耐嘅電量。'}

{'translation': 'Check out my hands-on review here.', 'original': '按此睇我嘅親身評測。'}

{'translation': "It's also one of the few models in the lineup that can double as a wall charger. There are foldable prongs on the back that can be plugged directly into a wall outlet to charge the internal battery while also serving as a wall charger — I love this design, because it means I don't have to carry an extra piece of gear just for charging.", 'original': '佢都係產品線中少數可以兼任牆插充電器嘅型號。背面有可摺疊嘅插腳，可以直接插入牆蘇為內置電池充電，同時當作牆插充電器使用——我好鍾意呢個設計，因為意味住我唔使額外帶多一件裝備只為充電。'}

{'translation': "Today's accessory and charger deals:", 'original': '今日配件同充電器優惠：'}

  • {'translation': 'This 140W 4-port charger can power your entire setup, today drops to $35 (41% off)', 'original': '呢款 140W 4 埠充電器可以為你整套裝置供電，今日跌至 35 美元（41 折）'}
  • {'translation': 'Charge your iPhone and AirPods with this dual Qi charging pad, now $30 (originally $70)', 'original': '用呢個雙 Qi 充電板為你嘅 iPhone 同 AirPods 充電，現售 30 美元（原價 70 美元）'}
  • {'translation': 'The 250W Anker Prime charging station with LCD display can replace six chargers, now from $95', 'original': '配備 LCD 顯示屏嘅 250W Anker Prime 充電站可取代六個充電器，現售 95 美元起'}
  • {'translation': 'Belkin 100W USB-C GaN wall charger drops to $25.50, an Amazon all-time low', 'original': 'Belkin 100W USB-C GaN 牆插充電器跌至 25.50 美元，創亞馬遜歷史新低'}
  • {'translation': "Satechi's latest ChargeView 140W desktop charger with display drops back to Prime Day low of $80", 'original': 'Satechi 最新配備顯示屏嘅 ChargeView 140W 桌面充電器回落至 Prime Day 低價 80 美元'}
  • {'translation': 'Add four Matter-certified Edison smart bulbs to your Apple, Google, or Alexa smart home, each under $8', 'original': '為你嘅 Apple、Google 或 Alexa 智能家居添加四個 Matter 認證 Edison 智能燈泡，每個低於 8 美元'}
  • {'translation': 'Add premium Matter-certified ambient lighting to your home, Govee 3-pack Permanent Outdoor Lights Prism, from $430', 'original': '為家居添加高級 Matter 認證氛圍燈光，Govee 三裝 Permanent Outdoor Lights Prism，售價 430 美元起'}
  • {'translation': 'Add this DOCKCASE 2-in-1 USB-C SD card reader to your tech organizer, today drops to $7 (53% off)', 'original': '將呢個 DOCKCASE 2 合 1 USB-C SD 卡讀卡器加入你嘅科技收納包，今日跌至 7 美元（53 折）'}
  • {'translation': 'Rare deal: Belkin 25W UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1 MagSafe stand hits Amazon all-time low', 'original': '罕見優惠：Belkin 25W UltraCharge Pro 3 合 1 MagSafe 座檯充電器創亞馬遜歷史新低'}
  • {'translation': "Anker's latest 45W Nano charger with smart display comes in multiple colors, holding at $26", 'original': 'Anker 最新配備智能顯示屏嘅 45W Nano 充電器有多種顏色可選，維持 26 美元優惠'}
  • {'translation': 'UGREEN FineTrack Slim Find My wallet tracker with MagSafe charging, today drops to $18', 'original': 'UGREEN FineTrack Slim Find My 銀包追蹤器支援 MagSafe 充電，今日跌至 18 美元'}
  • {'translation': 'This magnetic Apple Watch band drops to $20 today (save 41%)', 'original': '呢條磁吸 Apple Watch 錶帶今日跌至 20 美元（慳 41%）'}
  • {'translation': 'Anker 10-port flat power strip on Amazon drops to $20', 'original': 'Anker 10 埠扁插拖板現於亞馬遜跌至 20 美元'}

{'translation': 'Anker 3-port 160W smart display charger holds Prime Day price (33% off), other models from $8', 'original': 'Anker 3 埠 160W 智能顯示屏充電器維持 Prime Day 優惠價（67 折），其他型號 8 美元起'}

{'translation': "In addition to ongoing discounts on the Anker smart display Qi2 25W charger and the latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging station, we've also recorded the 3-port 160W Prime charger with display dropping back to its Prime Day price (33% off).", 'original': '除咗 Anker 智能顯示屏 Qi2 25W 充電器同最新 3 合 1 Qi2 25W 可摺疊 MagSafe 充電站嘅持續折扣之外，我哋亦都記錄到配備顯示屏嘅 3 埠 160W Prime 充電器回落至 Prime Day 價格（67 折）。'}

{'translation': "Amazon's official Anker store is currently selling the 3-port Prime charger with smart display for $99.99, with free shipping.", 'original': '亞馬遜官方 Anker 商店現正以 99.99 美元發售配備智能顯示屏嘅 3 埠 Prime 充電器，包郵。'}

{'translation': 'For a product that\'s essentially a wall charger, this price isn\'t exactly cheap, but it has a built-in smart display and delivers up to 160W "as compact as the AirPods Pro 3 charging case" — portable while being enough to handle all your devices.', 'original': '對一款本質上係牆插充電器嘅產品嚟講，呢個價位唔算平，但佢內置智能顯示屏，而且「同 AirPods Pro 3 充電盒一樣輕巧」就能輸出高達 160W——便攜同時足以應付你所有裝置。'}

{'translation': 'More specifically, it can output up to 140W from a single USB-C port, capable of charging a 16-inch MacBook Pro from 0% to 50% in 25 minutes.', 'original': '更具體嚟講，佢可以從單一 USB-C 埠輸出高達 140W，能夠喺 25 分鐘內將 16 吋 MacBook Pro 由 0% 充至 50%。'}

{'translation': 'Speaking of the smart display, it features AnkerSense View technology, allowing you to "monitor power in real-time via the screen, switch modes instantly, and unlock custom modes via Bluetooth through the app".', 'original': '講到智能顯示屏，佢配備 AnkerSense View 技術，讓你可以「透過螢幕實時監察電力、即時切換模式，並透過藍牙經應用程式解鎖自訂模式」。'}

{'translation': 'Anker 2026 summer sale from $8: smart display chargers, 25W 3-in-1 MagSafe stands, docks, car mounts, and more', 'original': 'Anker 2026 夏季優惠 8 美元起：智能顯示屏充電器、25W 3 合 1 MagSafe 座檯充電器、底座、車用支架等等'}

{'translation': 'Burton Goods debuts leather iPadfolio hybrid notebook for professionals [exclusive deal]', 'original': 'Burton Goods 首度為專業人士推出皮革 iPadfolio 混合筆記本【獨家優惠】'}
